note: Decatur County GA parcels are only offered through the qPublic viewer (not an ArcGIS REST service). The Property Appraiser's terms forbid automated scripts/scraping and bulk downloading without an agreement; shapefile exports are fee-based. The only ArcGIS parcel layer found (GDIT SmartGov FeatureServer/6) returns 'Invalid URL' / 400 for every request, including validation. No public queryable parcel service was found.
